title: Quote: There are lots of examples where not the best product wins. ...
speaker: Steve Jobs
content: There are lots of examples where not the best product wins. Windows would be one of those, but there are examples where the best product wins. And the iPod is a great example of that.
full_transcript: There are lots of examples where not the best product wins. Windows would be one of those, but there are examples where the best product wins. And the iPod is a great example of that.
